title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasizing on mutual learning and listening
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam  highlighting the virtues of mutual learning and  listening. He  remarked that those who are eager to learn and listen to one another are praised by the wise are free from selfish pursuits and ulterior motives, and they prosper in happiness in every way:
"ज्ञानवृद्धाः प्रशंसन्ति शुश्रूषन्तः परस्परम्।
विनिवृत्ताभिसन्धानाः सुखमेधन्ति सर्वशः॥"
The Prime Minister posted on X:
ज्ञानवृद्धाः प्रशंसन्ति शुश्रूषन्तः परस्परम्।
विनिवृत्ताभिसन्धानाः सुखमेधन्ति सर्वशः॥
ज्ञानवृद्धाः प्रशंसन्ति शुश्रूषन्तः परस्परम्। विनिवृत्ताभिसन्धानाः सुखमेधन्ति सर्वशः॥ pic.twitter.com/JoTDKpmwnM — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) August 26, 2026
****
MJPS/SS/VJ

enrichment.summary: The Prime Minister Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam (aphorism) on social media emphasizing the value of mutual learning and listening. The verse states that those who eagerly learn from and listen to one another are praised by the wise, remain free of selfish motives, and prosper in happiness. The post was made via his official X (Twitter) account on 26 August 2026.
enrichment.context: This release is part of a routine pattern where the Prime Minister's Office publicizes social media posts by the PM sharing quotes, cultural references, or greetings, often without any accompanying policy announcement. Such posts are typically aimed at promoting India's cultural and linguistic heritage, including Sanskrit literature, and reflect the government's broader emphasis on showcasing traditional Indian wisdom in public discourse. These releases have no substantive policy content and serve primarily as a record of the PM's public communications.
